senses.definition: One after the other; one at a time; in succession; successively.
senses.example: The teacher answered the students each in turn.

senses.definition: In due order; in proper sequence; in a determined or measured sequence, as a waiting line or queue.
senses.example: You are next in turn to bat.
The musical ambassadors finished their performance, and the local musicians in turn played for them a traditional ballad.

senses.definition: Having a relationship sequentially comparable to one just mentioned; accordingly or similarly, with respect to sequence, precedence, or hierarchy.
senses.example: The vassals were subject to their lords, who in turn were subject to barons or kings.
